item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Why does it liquefy the insides? Why does it even act like an animal? If I'm honest that second question nearly made me +1 vote this, but as a lot of people have mentioned something is… wrong…

Why does it eat? Why does it eat, why, why, why, why? Some form of energy source? It uses the slurry as a means to generate electricity? I wish we had a little more information on where the proboscis attaches too. Is it some form of reservoir? A battery? Nothing!? Some information would be appreciated, otherwise you might as well write 'it pretends to be an animal and pretends to eat the slurry it extracts. No reason known'.

Its quirky enough to be an SCP but… A Predator Drone? World play can only get an article so far, it needs realistic content…. Or at least content that can be construed to be realistic.
It feels old, it is sorta old, but it's withstood the test of time well.
